title: Driver Services Agreement Terms: One Agreement per Driver and the Reapplication Wait
content:
**Clause 1. One agreement at a time.** Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product a driver holds one Wayfare driver services agreement at a time (at most 1 agreement per driver). Changing service level is a level change on that agreement, not a second agreement.

**Clause 2. When a new agreement may be signed.** A new agreement may be signed only when the driver has no agreement in applied, screening, active, on hold or deactivated status. This is read from the driver's agreements as the system records them, matched to the driver by the driver's customer reference.

**Clause 3. Reapplication wait after a closing for cause.** After an agreement closed for cause, a new agreement may be signed only once the reapplication wait has passed. The reapplication wait is counted in calendar months from the closed date: the driver may sign again on or after the same day-of-month the reapplication wait (in months, from the level schedule) later, or the last day of that month when the day does not exist. The day so reached is itself a permitted signing day.

**Clause 4. No wait.** An agreement closed by the driver's own choice or after a failed screening carries no wait.

## Condition and result

| Driver's existing agreements (system record) | New agreement |
|---|---|
| One in applied, screening, active, on hold or deactivated status | may not be signed |
| Only closed agreements, the latest closed for cause, reapplication day not yet reached | may not be signed |
| Only closed agreements, the latest closed for cause, on or after the reapplication day | may be signed (subject to Clause 2) |
| Only closed agreements closed by the driver's own choice or after a failed screening | no wait applies |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 12-month wait)

- Closed for cause on 2025-03-10. The reapplication day is 2026-03-10. Signing on 2026-03-10 is permitted; signing on 2026-03-09 is not.
- Closed for cause on 2025-01-31. Twelve months later is January 2026, and the 31st exists, so the reapplication day is 2026-01-31.
- Closed for cause on 2024-02-29. Twelve months later is February 2025, which has no 29th, so the reapplication day is the last day of that month, 2025-02-28.

## Points of judgement

- The closed date and the status of each agreement come from the system record, not from what the driver says.
- A deactivated agreement still blocks a new signing under Clause 2, whatever its reason.
